reviewThemes.quote: Twenty-minute line for one croissant on a Saturday.
Great pastry, but $6 is hard to justify every week.
Had to eat standing outside in the rain.
Felt rushed and ignored at the counter.
Perfect on Monday, burnt on Thursday.

suggestions.title: Advertise how fast you are
suggestions.why: 57 reviews of nearby bakeries complain about waits. Yours is about 6 min, versus about 9 min on average nearby. Put “ready in about 6 minutes” on your Google listing and storefront.

suggestions.title: Test a small price increase
suggestions.why: You average $4.25 per item; nearby bakeries average $4.94, 14% higher. Try +$0.35 on your top three items for two weeks and watch daily sales.

suggestions.title: Ask regulars for reviews
suggestions.why: You have 142 reviews; nearby bakeries average about 700, and your 4.3 rating sits just under their 4.4. A QR code at the register can close that gap within a month.

suggestions.title: Show off your seating
suggestions.why: 24 reviews say competitors have nowhere to sit. If you have tables, put them in your listing photos so people searching nearby see it.
